Travel season, steady and bright
The relief team are ready
Clear steps for calm travel

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is keeping standards firm and practical this season. Staff should give passengers brief, direct guidance before departure and confirm every carrier, strap, and label with care. <<FACT F002>> The lounge remains a point of steady oversight, and every handoff should be handled with calm attention.

On board, the cabin team continues to watch animals closely and report any concern without delay. <<FACT F023>> Travelers should arrive prepared, follow the guidance given, and remember that each journey is a shared responsibility. The service works best when everyone stays attentive, kind, and orderly from check-in to arrival.
